difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that the property that the local ring of the fibre at a point is Noetherian and Gorenstein is etale local on source and target at a point. The proof passes to etale neighbourhoods, identifies the local ring of the fibre in the neighbourhood with the corresponding ring over the original point, and verifies that Noetherianness and the Gorenstein property are preserved under the etale maps involved. Comparing the local rings through the etale neighbourhoods is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 6496-6512.
